generator_validity_protocol.amendment: The inherited .001 primary rule and stricter sensitivities were frozen prospectively for H5, before any holdout. The retained historical note concerns the original reduced study, not a post-hoc H5 change.
generator_validity_protocol.historical_rule_note: Changed after initial blocks; existing evidence is retrospective under this rule. D2 exact arrival matching is approximated, not proven by aggregate accuracy. Report sensitivity and start-lag diagnostics.

slo_definition: End-to-end: non-200 or transport failure or latency > configured threshold, divided by all attempted requests; success-only latency reported separately. D3 does not specify failure accounting; this conservative operational definition must be frozen before execution. Generator skips remain separate; reconciled trials must satisfy the explicit generator accuracy budget. Skips never enter the Cloud SLO denominator.

correctness.reason: Passing functional trials check event sets, dependency and grant order; duplicate domain effects and complete grant-bound eligibility coverage require separate witnesses.

fairness.reason: Per-site metrics report grant/completion/cost shares, retries, sampled bounds, CPU and memory. Finite-prefix fairness is not a sustained fairness guarantee.

full_D2_D3: not established: requires reviewed sustainable representative capacity, preregistered skewed dependency case, complete matrix and correctness witnesses
uncertainty_note: Seed is the unit; bootstrap and exact sign-flip uncertainty are separate from observer intervals. Targets use point estimates, not a significance claim.

generator_validity.scope: trial aggregate accuracy; report start-lag diagnostics

protocol.capacity_scope: 36/84 RPS against provisional 120 RPS existing-record read-only reference; not maximum sustainable mixed capacity
protocol.slo_definition: non-200 OR transport failure OR latency > live_slo_ms; denominator all attempted requests
protocol.arrival_model: same deterministic constant-rate schedule and existing-record read fixture semantics; common prefix until each trial drains
protocol.backlog_note: 88 is the minimum exact-ratio full-chain design, not a proposal-prescribed sample size; verify sustained recovery before expansion
protocol.selection: Five pre-reserved seeds; balanced admission and required skewed scheduler comparisons; no replacements or adaptive sample expansion
protocol.experimental_review: Historical approvals do not approve newer pressure-health/bounded-deferral policies; owner review remains required

limitations: Two workload shapes at two provisional read loads, not full D2 or maximum sustainable mixed capacity.
Pressure-health and bounded-deferral are experimental and require component review; healthy-load recovery is not overload protection.
Routine workflow completion after observed reconnection is a waiting proxy; no isolated scheduler CPU cost.
Five paired seeds cannot give a two-sided exact sign-flip p-value below .0625.
A-only urgency gives no urgent B population. Both hospitals routine outcomes are retained.
Whole-run end-to-end SLO is primary. Fixed ten-second readiness-aligned diagnostics are secondary.
